abstract: Covers the OpenAPI Overlay Specification 1.2.0, with compatibility for 1.1.0: the Overlay, Info, Components, Action, Reusable Action and Reusable Action Reference Objects, the update, copy and remove semantics and recursive merge rules, RFC 9535 JSONPath targets, upgrading from 1.1, validation against the Overlay JSON Schemas (the 1.2 schema is still unpublished and pinned to a work-in-progress commit), and safe application in pipelines. The 1.3 milestone is tracked only. SKILL.md holds the invariants and workflow; references split out objects, recipes, versions and safety.
